Oh no, I can see why you're worried! Unfortunately, the prepaid label **expires after 7 days**, so if you printed it 9 days ago, it's no longer valid. 😟

But don't worry—this is fixable! Here's what to do:

- Go back to **"My Orders"** and start a new return for the watering can.
- A fresh prepaid label will be emailed to you.
- This time, make sure to drop the parcel off **within 7 days** so the label doesn't expire again.

You'll be back on track, and everything else stays the same—the $6.95 change-of-mind fee (or free if you're a Leafy Plus member) and the **5 business day** refund timeframe.

I know it's a bit of a hassle, but you've got this! If you have any other questions or run into trouble, just reach out. I'm here to help. 🌱
